diff --git a/test/integration/targets/ansible-galaxy-collection/tasks/upgrade.yml b/test/integration/targets/ansible-galaxy-collection/tasks/upgrade.yml
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..1f7aef6
--- /dev/null
+++ b/test/integration/targets/ansible-galaxy-collection/tasks/upgrade.yml
@@ -0,0 +1,27 @@
+---
+- name: install an older collection for upgrade
+  command: ansible-galaxy collection install namespace1.name1:1.0.0 -s galaxy_ng -p '{{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade_collections'
+
+- name: upgrade the collection within a version constraint
+  command: ansible-galaxy collection install --upgrade 'namespace1.name1:<1.1.0' -s galaxy_ng -p '{{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade_collections'
+  register: upgrade_result
+
+- name: verify the upgraded version
+  slurp:
+    path: '{{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade_collections/ansible_collections/namespace1/name1/MANIFEST.json'
+  register: upgraded_manifest
+
+- name: assert the latest permitted version was installed
+  assert:
+    that:
+      - (upgraded_manifest.content | b64decode | from_json).collection_info.version == '1.0.9'
+
+- name: repeat the upgrade
+  command: ansible-galaxy collection install -U 'namespace1.name1:<1.1.0' -s galaxy_ng -p '{{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade_collections'
+  register: repeat_upgrade
+
+- name: assert the second upgrade is idempotent
+  assert:
+    that:
+      - "'Skipping' in repeat_upgrade.stdout"
+      - "'Installing' not in repeat_upgrade.stdout"
